language.label: Language
language.description: The language qnop's interface appears in.
language.saveFailed: Your language choice could not be saved.

boundary.title: Something went wrong
boundary.message: This part of the page ran into an unexpected error. You can try again, or reload the page if it keeps happening.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.invalidOrExpiredLink: The request is invalid or the link has expired.

notFound.title: This page folded itself into a paper plane
notFound.message: Wherever it landed, it isn't at this address. Head back to the dashboard and pick up your quest from there.

forbidden.title: This binder is locked
forbidden.message: Your account doesn't have access to this area. If your quest leads through here, an administrator can hand you the key.

featureUnavailable.title: Not part of this deployment
featureUnavailable.message: This qnop installation doesn't offer this feature. Nothing about your account changes that — whoever operates this deployment decides, and can turn it back on.

conflict.title: Two pins landed on the same line
conflict.message: Someone changed this while you were on your way to it. Reload to see the current state - nothing of yours was lost.

serverError.title: Our shredder grabbed the wrong document
serverError.message: Something broke on our side - not your doing. Trying again usually works; if it keeps happening, your admin will want to know.

maintenance.title: Out to lunch - back shortly
maintenance.message: qnop is patching itself up. Your reviews are safe in the cabinet; give it a moment and try again.

rateLimit.title: Easy there, stamp champion
rateLimit.message: That was a lot of requests in a very short time. Take a breath - a moment from now everything works again.

offline.title: The string between our paper cups snapped
offline.message: You seem to be offline. Nothing is lost - once the connection is back, everything picks up where it stopped.

search.title: Search
search.description: Reviews, people and teams across your workspace — scoped to what you may see.
search.tooShort_one: Type at least {{count}} character to search.
search.tooShort_other: Type at least {{count}} characters to search.
search.resultsHint: Every hit deep-links to its page.

quota.ceilingNote: The ceiling is set where this deployment is configured, not in the admin settings.

attachments.title: Review attachment
attachments.description: This file was attached to an annotation. Download it to your device.
attachments.unavailable: This file is not available. It may have been deleted, or the review may not be shared with you.

fieldErrors.INVALID_EMAIL: must be a valid email address
fieldErrors.INVALID_URL: must be a valid http(s) URL
fieldErrors.INVALID_TIMEZONE: must be a valid IANA timezone id
fieldErrors.INVALID_LANGUAGE: must be a two-letter ISO 639-1 language code
